messages:
maria: Customer (ACME) reports duplicate downstream actions after our function_call retried. They see double emails and duplicate DB inserts. Repro steps attached. Ticket INC-987. Any known flow where a 202 accepted leads to re-execution?

sam: Can you paste the exact request + response? 202 is 'accepted' — if we don't return an operation id the client may retry.

maria: Here's the customer's curl and response from their logs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"Process order","function_call":true}'
```
Response snippet:
```json
{"status":202, "body": {"message": "accepted"}}
```
They say their client retried after a client-side timeout and the tool ran twice.

jordan: Do they send an Idempotency-Key header? If the client retries at the network layer and we don't dedupe at the dispatcher, double execution is possible. Also check webhook delivery semantics to their downstream.

ryan: @jordan we currently support Idempotency-Key for the explicit /v1/call-tool endpoint, but function_call autosubmission path does not consistently echo or enforce it. Might be the gap.

maria: Logs for customer show two separate request IDs ~1s apart: trace=tr_0abC... and trace=tr_0abD... Both resulted in downstream POSTs to https://acme.example.com/api/send-email with different exec_id fields.

sam: Hypothesis: runtime returns 202 with no operation_id and no KV entry for the request; client retries and we accept a second request as new. Fixes: 1) return operation_id in 202 body; 2) use Idempotency-Key to dedupe at dispatcher; 3) make autosubmission path idempotent.

deploy-bot: created incident INC-987 and added to opsqueue (sam assigned) :white_check_mark:

jordan: Short-term ask for customer: add Idempotency-Key (e.g., UUID) in header so we can correlate retries. We'll implement server-side enforcement after PR.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll open PR to ensure the dispatcher stores a minimal KV entry on first accept and echoes operation_id in 202 responses. Also add a dedupe check that looks for identical payload + Idempotency-Key. ETA: 4h for code + canary.

billing-bot: Alert: billing anomaly for acme@example.com — +2.3% token/billing usage in the last hour, possible duplicate charges; flagged for billing team review.

maria: Communicated workaround to customer (add Idempotency-Key) and asked them to share full raw logs. They turned on client idempotency and will retest. I'll update once they confirm. :eyes:
